title: Fast Horse
description: Fast Horse is a comprehensive enhancement mod designed to transform your equestrian experience into a thrilling, high-speed adventure, while maintaining perfect compatibility with vanilla mechanics.
body:
Fast Horse: Unleash the True Potential of Your Steed
Are you tired of the sluggish, predictable movement of horses in the base game? Fast Horse is a comprehensive enhancement mod designed to transform your equestrian experience into a thrilling, high-speed adventure, while maintaining perfect compatibility with vanilla mechanics.

Core Features:

Dynamic Apple Boost System: Simply keep an apple in your first hotbar slot. When you are mounted, your horse will automatically consume it to trigger a 15-second 2x speed boost. Feel the rush of the open world like never before!

Instant Potion Injection: Right-click your mount with a Speed Potion to instantly inject it with a 4x to 8x long-lasting speed effect, allowing you to traverse vast maps with ease.

"Zero Fall Damage" Mechanic: Through deep engine optimization, the mod continuously resets your horse's fall distance while sprinting at high speeds. Your legendary mount can now land safely even from the steepest cliffs—making you completely immune to fall damage.

How This Mod Elevates Your Experience:

Elite "Golden Apple" Breeding: When both parent horses are fed Golden Apples, they will produce an elite foal with potential far exceeding their own, effectively breaking the vanilla stat caps.

Integrated Stat Tracking: Your horse’s speed and jump strength are displayed directly via its custom name. For example, a name like "3432,9781" represents a Movement Speed of 0.3432 and a Jump Strength of 0.9781.


您是否對原版遊戲中緩慢、無聊的騎馬移動感到厭倦？Fast Horse 是一款全方位的馬匹強化模組，旨在將騎乘體驗升級為一場驚險刺激的高速冒險，同時完美兼容原版遊戲機制。

核心特色：

 

動態蘋果推進系統： 只需將蘋果放在快捷欄的第一格，當您騎乘時，馬匹會自動消耗蘋果，獲得 15 秒的2倍數極速推進效果。感受前所未有的速度快感！

藥水速效注入： 只需對馬匹右鍵使用速度藥水，即可立即為坐騎注入4倍至8倍且長效的極速效果，輕鬆穿越廣闊的地圖。

「零墜落傷害」機制： 透過底層引擎優化，在馬匹高速奔跑時強制重置墜落距離，讓您的傳奇坐騎在險峻的峽谷中也能平安落地，徹底免疫墜落傷害。

這款模組如何提升您的體驗：

金蘋果優生小馬:當兩匹馬都要金蘋果餵食時,繁殖時能獲得優於父母的潛力，突破原版馬匹的屬性上限，並透過名字顯示速度及跳躍力。

3432,9781代表速度0.3432 跳躍力0.9781

 

釋放您坐騎的真正潛力。立即下載 Fast Horse，以風馳電掣的速度重新發現這個世界！
